digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria tagging and completion verification
propositions: The canonical AC qualifier tag must be renamed from [operator-attested] to [non-codebase] while retaining the old spelling as an undocumented compatibility alias for 827 immutable persisted records.

The shared Python regex matcher and .rebar/criteria_routing.json activation trigger must be widened to accept both [non-codebase] and [operator-attested] case-insensitively using a non-capturing alternation.

The completion-verdict kind wire value must transition from "operator-attested" to "non-codebase" with reader-side widening sequenced before emitter-side changes to preserve rendering of legacy persisted verdicts.
All author-facing documentation, prompts, and guidance must emit [non-codebase] exclusively while recognition-side prompts must instruct that both spellings are accepted by the LLM.

The deterministic matcher and LLM classification vocabulary must be cut over in lockstep across completion_verifier.md, contracts.py, completion_verdict.schema.json, and both criteria_routing.json files to prevent divergence.

All existing tests using [operator-attested] must pass unchanged to demonstrate the compatibility alias functions correctly, with parametrized suites proving identical outcomes across plan-time lint, laundering guard, provenance guard, close path, and audit rendering.
